_comment: The ONE table of e2e flows: run order for scripts/e2e-maestro.sh and the row metadata for scripts/e2e-report.py. 'slot' is the link the flow types (a slot in scripts/e2e-env.json; the runner passes the resolved URL as LINK_URL). 'expected' must say what the flow's yaml asserts (and, for click-token flows, what scripts/e2e-verify.sh checks on the backend); {product} and {voucher} are filled in from the run's expectations. 'link_type_matrix': true (every link type whose reward needs no events) or a list of link types; the flow also runs once per such link type (scripts/e2e-env.json link_types) as <flow>__<type>. 'link_type_only': the flow runs ONLY per link type (never on its slot's own link); the re-engagement flows (reengage_*) use it.

Opened with simctl openurl via the DEBUG kickflip://e2e-universal-link forwarder (unsigned sim build: no Associated Domains)

Opened with simctl openurl via the DEBUG kickflip://e2e-universal-link forwarder (unsigned sim build: no Associated Domains)

{product} + {voucher} voucher, counted install, then the reward's events via the DEBUG kickflip://e2e-track hook: per_event sends reward.eventName twice + one other event, earning = 2 × reward.amountMinor; rev_share sends one revenue event (reward_events.revenue_minor in the reward currency) plus the same in another currency, earning = floor(revenue_minor × reward.rateBps / 10000); general (no reward) sends the revenue event twice + one other event, earning 0; the click's events (count, byName, revenue per currency) must match what was sent; the app's footer must show every event sent and attributed

{product} + {voucher} voucher (tracking denied, paste allowed: routed, not tracked), nothing counted; the same events are requested but the SDK drops them (footer: sent 0, attributed 0), earning 0, events.count 0
